objective: Close the approved product as genuinely self-administered. Code presence is not acceptance; each save must persist through the server-owned write authority and be visible again from canonical reads.
invariants: No person identity, including Samuel or Carlos, may be hardcoded as product behavior or a required user record.
Team users are created, edited, activated/deactivated, assigned roles/countries/scopes and access-provisioned from Equipo y permisos.
Browser optimistic state is never proof of persistence; self-admin Save is successful only after the protected backend commit resolves.
Multi-collection business operations use one server-owned transaction/batch or another explicit atomic contract.
Canonical readback after commit is the visual authority; localStorage, seed, legacy namespaces and conversation history are not operational authority.
Approved modules are reused; findings are mini-corrections inside A or D, not redesigns or parallel methodologies.
Cobro is never inferred from a receipt schedule or cartera balance; confirmed payment lifecycle closes separately in I6.6.
Cross-module workflows preserve actor, tenant, role, audit, notification/synchronization outcome and fail-closed behavior.

items.required: Create/edit/delete users from Equipo, persist advisor, activate/deactivate access safely, optionally provision/sync Auth+membership, roles, countries, scopes and credentials; no hardcoded people.
items.evidence: R4: canonical Team hydration; refresh-safe Auth restore; linked-membership prereads before writes; auditable logical delete with access blocking; canonical readback; explicit verification-mail result.

items.required: Create/edit clients from platform and confirm canonical readback plus linked activity.
items.evidence: Create/edit client await one server-owned batch with linked activity and canonical readback before close/refresh.

items.required: Create/edit policy from platform; policy+receipts+cartera remain synchronized and atomic; no automatic cobro.
items.evidence: Create/edit policy plan póliza + recibosEsperados + carteraPrimas (+ vehicle/activity when applicable) and commit via one existing orbit360ProductOperationalCommand transaction; zero cobros are synthesized.

items.required: Modify insurers with persistent readback; secure credentials stay protected; login logo/favicon/build freshness corrected.
items.evidence: Insurer edit awaits server-owned durable batch/readback; sensitive credentials stay with secure owner; stale orbitBuild is removed only after runtime/server build equality.

items.required: Create/update/reconcile confirmed payments from platform with auditable links to receipt/policy and no inference.
Ops/Leads transitions remain server-owned semantic workflows and synchronize Cliente360, policy/client links and activity.
Client portal and Cliente360 consume the same canonical state and never create alternate persistence.
Notifications/automation fire only after committed domain events and expose failure/retry state without duplicating records.

acceptance.release: BUILD_ONCE -> PREVIEW -> AUTHENTICATED_PROOF -> SAME_ARTIFACT_LIVE -> EXACT_READBACK -> FREEZE_OR_ROLLBACK

forbidden: silent fire-and-forget success for self-admin saves

runtimeCompositionFinding.rootCause: core/user-onboarding.js depended on legacy window.firebase compat auth while the certified product runtime authenticates through productRuntimeBrowserProvidersP0 modular Firebase; onboarding bridge therefore loaded but declared backend unavailable.
runtimeCompositionFinding.probeFalseFailureCause: Operational duplicate-insert probe omitted an explicit requestId, so deterministic idempotent replay could return a previously committed result before duplicate-target validation.
runtimeCompositionFinding.fix: Reuse existing owners only: bind user onboarding to productRuntimeBrowserProvidersP0 initialize/callFunction and modular sendPasswordResetEmail; keep duplicate-insert zero-write proof but use a unique requestId per run.
runtimeCompositionFinding.a2RootCause: Cliente 360 create/edit closed after optimistic Orbit.store writes without waiting for canonical server readback.
runtimeCompositionFinding.a3RootCause: Policy engine issued policy, receipts and portfolio as independent operational commands; browser try/catch could not guarantee all-or-nothing multi-collection persistence.
runtimeCompositionFinding.a4RootCause: Insurer save waited legacy backend events while product facade emits operational events; current runtime retained a stale orbitBuild query after freshness was already current.
runtimeCompositionFinding.correction: Reuse existing orbit360ProductOperationalCommand through batchDurable with canonical readback; no backend parallel, no new collections, no cobros synthesis.
